meta.name: github-triage
meta.description: Read-only GitHub triage for issues AND PRs. 1 item = 1 background task (category: quick). Analyzes all open items and writes evidence-backed reports to /tmp/{datetime}/. Every claim requires a GitHub permalink as proof. NEVER takes any action on GitHub - no comments, no merges, no closes, no labels. Reports only. Triggers: 'triage', 'triage issues', 'triage PRs', 'github triage'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动分析 GitHub 仓库的所有议题和 PR，生成带证据的审阅报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要快速了解仓库中所有待办事项的现状和优先级
copy.tagline_en: Analyze all open issues and PRs on GitHub, generating evidence-backed triage reports
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a quick overview of all open items in a GitHub repository with evidence

howto.what: 触发后,Claude 会抓取仓库全部未关闭的 issue 与 PR,逐个分析并写报告到 /tmp 时间戳文件夹;每条结论都附 GitHub 跳转链接证明,全程只读、不改动 GitHub。
howto.when: 当你说出“triage”、“triage issues”、“triage PRs”等开场指令时触发。

say.text: 帮我 triage 这个仓库的 issue
say.note: 会读取所有未关闭 issue 并生成分析报告
对未合并的 pull request 做只读分析并写报告
对整个仓库的 issue 和 PR 统一扫描

howto.what_en: On trigger, Claude fetches all open issues and PRs, analyzes each item in a background subagent, and writes one report per item under /tmp/{timestamp}/. Every claim must include a GitHub permalink as proof; it never comments, merges, closes, or labels anything on GitHub.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say 'triage', 'triage issues', 'triage PRs', or similar triage-related starting commands.

say_en.text: triage the issues in this repo
say_en.note: It will analyze all open issues and produce reports.
Read-only analysis of all open pull requests.
Scan all open issues and PRs in the repo.
